title: AI Capability Taxonomy Entry
description: Schema for a single capability classification entry. Each taxonomy/*.md file MUST have YAML frontmatter conforming to this schema.

id.description: Stable identifier. Format: CLASS-SUBCLASS-NNN. Once published, MUST NOT change.

name.description: Short descriptive name of the capability classification.

severity.description: Relative severity of an observation against this classification. Descriptive, not prescriptive.

introduced.description: ISO 8601 date the entry was first published.

deprecated.description: ISO 8601 date the entry was marked deprecated. Required when status=deprecated.

supersededBy.description: ID of the entry that replaces this one. Used together with status=deprecated.
